name.description: Short name, e.g. 'fraud' or 'audit-trail'. Becomes mfe-<name> (domain) or mfe-cap-<name> (capability). A name that already starts with 'mfe-' is used as is.

kind.description: domain = a section exposing ./Routes (case, 360 or reporting family; case domains are mounted as tabs of the case-management hub). capability = one component for case tabs/panels. hub = a section that hosts other domain remotes as tabs (e.g. mfe-case-management).

family.description: Layout family (domain only). Decides which layout lib the app may import and its nav group. (`--family=360` is parsed as a number by the CLI; both forms are accepted.)

caseDomain.description: Case family only (required there): the CaseDomain this section serves. Drives the generated CaseDomainConfig and the shell's case-search routing.

route.description: Domain only: URL segment under the shell (default: name).

label.description: Domain only: left-nav label (default: Title Case of name).

entitlement.description: Domain only: entitlement to see the section (default: '<route>:view').

exposedName.description: Capability only: exposed module name, e.g. 'AuditTrail' -> './AuditTrail' (default: PascalCase of name).

port.description: Local dev-server port (default: next free port from the local manifest, starting at 4201).
